units.source_text: 不用说，对秩序来说，若说给予与此相称的生命保证，那也就还有让步的余地。

en.t: Needless to say, as far as order is concerned, if it were to provide a guarantee of life worthy of that, there would still be room for compromise.

units.source_text: 但是，现实究竟怎么样呢？

en.t: But what is reality actually like?

units.source_text: 天空落下了死的荆棘，地上也是布满所有种类的死，连立脚的地方也没有。

en.t: Thorns of death fell from the sky, and the earth too was filled with every kind of death, leaving not even a place to stand.

units.source_text: 性也开始稍许感受到了，好像只能够抓住空头支票，

en.t: Sex too began to feel it a little, as though all it could grasp were empty promissory notes,

units.source_text: 于是，开始伪造起不服之“性”的联票。

en.t: and so it began forging joint notes of dissatisfied “sex.”

units.source_text: 这玩意儿可是个好买卖。

en.t: This thing is quite a profitable business.

units.source_text: 也许，把精神性的强奸作为必要之恶，予以默认。

en.t: Perhaps mental rape is tacitly accepted as a necessary evil.

units.source_text: 没有这玩意儿，所有的婚姻几乎都不能成立。

en.t: Without this thing, almost no marriage could stand.

units.source_text: 性解放者干的也是大同小异的事。

en.t: The sexual liberationists are doing much the same thing.

units.source_text: 他们不就是把互相强奸的事更加合理化吗？

en.t: Aren’t they simply making mutual rape even more rationalized?

units.source_text: 你觉得是这么回事，那也就相当快活了。

en.t: If you think that is what it amounts to, then you can be fairly pleased with it.

units.source_text: 可是，不间断地留意封闭不严的窗帘，

en.t: But if you must constantly keep watch on curtains that do not close properly,

units.source_text: 这种解放，你就是再不愿意，也只能成为精神性的性病患者。

en.t: with this kind of liberation, however unwilling you may be, you can only become a mental venereal-disease patient.

units.source_text: 可怜的下体，再没有脱帽子歇一歇的余地喽。

en.t: The poor lower body no longer has even a chance to take off its hat and rest.
